mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , t1.WONBON_AEK AS wonbon_aek , t1.USD_WONBON_AEK AS usd_wonbon_aek , t1.JM_PER AS jm_per , t1.YEAR_BETA AS year_beta , t1.MON_BETA AS mon_beta , t1.RISK_VALUE AS risk_value , t1.OPT_PREMIUM AS opt_premium , t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT AS opt_nominal_amt , TO_CHAR(port.FYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fymd , TO_CHAR(port.TYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tymd , port.PORT_NUM AS port_num , port.TT AS tt , port.INST_DAYS AS inst_days , TO_CHAR(port.MANGI, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mangi , port.DT AS dt , port.USD_TUJA AS uspm_port_usd_tuja , port.YEAR_BETA AS uspm_port_year_beta , port.MON_BETA AS uspm_port_mon_beta , ROUND(t1.USD_WONBON_AEK * t1.JM_PER / 100, 2) AS usd_tuja FROM SZT0IA_V t1 , SZM0IA ia , USPM_PORT port WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = #{ymd} AND NVL(t1.DEL,'N') = 'N' AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND port.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND port.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND port.MANGI > #{ymd} AND port.TYMD = t1.TR_YMD ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC, port.PORT_NUM ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , ya.JM_NM AS xx_yj_cd , t1.USD_TUJA AS usd_tuja , t1.TARGET_RETURN_PER AS target_return_per , opt.STOCK_CHUI AS stock_chui , opt.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT AS opt_nominal_amt , yz.JM_CD AS jm_cd , opt_jm.JM_NM AS jm_nm , opt_jm.HANGSA_GA AS hangsa_ga , TO_CHAR(opt_jm.LSY_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS lsy_ymd , NVL(yz.TR_BFIL_JUSU, 0) + NVL(yz.TR_UP_JUSU, 0) - NVL(yz.TR_DW_JUSU, 0) + NVL(yz.RIGHT_JUSU, 0) AS tr_jusu , NVL(yz.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(yz.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK, 0) - NVL(yz.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(yz.RIGHT_AEK, 0) AS tr_aek , yz.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT AS sym0yz_opt_nominal_amt , CASE yz.SM_TR_GB When '3' THEN 'S71' When '4' THEN 'S81' When '5' THEN 'S91' When '6' THEN 'SA1' ELSE '' END AS tr_cd , 0 AS order_su , 0 AS order_aek , (NVL(t1.USD_TUJA, 0) - NVL(opt.STOCK_CHUI, 0) - NVL(opt.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT, 0)) AS settable_amount , ya.CURRENCY AS currency FROM USPM t1 , USPM_OPT opt , SYM0YA ya , SYM0YZ yz , SYM0YA opt_jm WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.YMD = #{ymd} AND t1.PORT_NUM = #{portNum} AND opt.PORT = '(' || t1.PORT_NUM || ')' AND opt.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND opt.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND opt.YMD = t1.YMD AND opt.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND yz.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND yz.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND yz.YMD = t1.YMD AND opt_jm.CORP_GR = yz.CORP_GR AND opt_jm.JM_CD = yz.JM_CD AND opt_jm.CHANGE_JM_CD = t1.JM_CD ORDER BY opt_jm.LSY_YMD ASC, t1.JM_CD ASC
